findings.claim: The requirement says MessagePack attributes on T must be honoured when present. The change never reads attributes on T. With no surrogate it always uses contractless mode over every public read-write member. So `[MessagePackObject]`, `[Key]`, `[IgnoreMember]` (and `[DataContract]`/`[DataMember]`) on a referenced T are ignored. For example, an `[IgnoreMember]` member is still serialized, and int keys become string keys. Ledger L19 says to follow the requirement here.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.GeneratedFormatterHonoursAttributesTests.IgnoreMemberOnReferencedMessagePackObjectIsHonoured. T comes from a referenced assembly, carries [MessagePackObject] and has `[IgnoreMember] public string Secret`. The generated sources must not mention 'Secret'; on head they do because CreateContractlessMembers includes it.

findings.claim: The formatter body is only emitted through the main source output, which is gated on `Options.IsGeneratingSource`. If that flag requires a `[GeneratedMessagePackResolver]` class in the project, a project that only declares `[GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] partial class X : IMessagePackFormatter<T>;` gets no generated body. The user then sees CS0535 (interface not implemented) and no MessagePack diagnostic, even though the requirement says the class needs no body.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the CSharpGeneratorDriver on a compilation with only the bodyless formatter declaration (no [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]) against a referenced ProjectA type. Check whether output.GetDiagnostics() contains CS0535. Unverified: depends on how AnalyzerOptions.IsGeneratingSource is computed.

questions.text: Must [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] produce the formatter body even when the project declares no [GeneratedMessagePackResolver] class?
options: Yes, the formatter must be generated standalone
No, a [GeneratedMessagePackResolver] in the project is a documented prerequisite
questions.why_it_matters: If yes, gating the formatter output on IsGeneratingSource is a requirement gap: bodyless declarations fail with CS0535. If no, the current gating is fine, but the README and the attribute docs should state the prerequisite.
